title: Field Resilience Runbook for VPC and Air-Gapped Deploys
author: Aisha Kapoor
content:
Overview

Purpose: This runbook documents operator-safe procedures and automated guardrails to recover and preserve tenant safety when VPC-based or air-gapped Private deployments experience infrastructure or runtime degradation that could cause tenant data exposure, SLA violations, or unsafe model swaps. It focuses on fast, auditable, and reversible actions for field operators and SREs.

Scope: Applies to Redwood Private installations with VPC control plane proxies and fully air-gapped on-prem nodes managed by operators. Includes tenant evacuation, model swap reversal, KV-cache reconciliation, ingress/egress isolation, and evidence collection for compliance. Does NOT replace vendor-specific hardware recovery (see hardware vendor runbooks).

Owner and escalation

- Primary owner: Engineering — Private Deployments (oncall: private-deploys-sre@redwood.com)
- Secondary owner: Eng SRE (oncall: eng-sre@redwood.com)
- Product contact (business impact): Product Ops (product-ops@redwood.com)
- Escalation matrix:
  1. Operator on call (first 15 minutes)
  2. Private Deploys SRE lead (15–60 minutes)
  3. Head of Eng Platform (60+ minutes)

SLOs and thresholds (operator triggers)

- Tenant 99th perc latency (api-gateway -> runtime): 800 ms (alert if > 1.5x for 5m)
- Token throughput degradation: >25% loss of baseline for 10m -> trigger evacuation planning
- Failed model swap rate: >5% of requests returning model-mismatch/unsupported error in 5m -> immediate rollback
- Data-path leakage detection: any unexpected egress endpoint observed -> immediate isolation

Quick reference table

| Symptom | Immediate action | Owner | Ticket priority | Evidence required |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| High 99p latency | Check runtime health, enable safemode degrader | Operator | P1 | latency trace + model version |
| Model swap failures | Rollback to pinned model; disable rollouts | Operator | P1 | swap logs + request traces |
| Unexpected outbound IPs | Quarantine node; block egress; notify security | SecOps + Operator | P0 | network captures + audit logs |
| KV cache corruption | Isolate tenant, snapshot state, run reconcile | Operator + Runtime | P1 | kv snapshots + checksums |

Immediate recovery checklist (ordered)

1. Triage (first 5 minutes)
   - Confirm alert sources: console dashboard, metrics (Prometheus), and synthetic tests.
   - Capture a live snapshot: `rdwctl snapshot --scope incident --out /tmp/incident-YYYYMMDD.tgz` (operator CLI).
   - Open incident ticket and tag: INCIDENT-PRIV-<YYYYMMDD>-<NN>. Include initial hypothesis.

2. Isolation (5–15 minutes)
   - If suspected data egress, run egress-block command: `rdwctl network block-egress --scope node-group --duration 15m --reason "suspected-evidence"`
   - For VPC deployments, update route table to blackhole problematic CIDRs or use the management proxy to disable external NAT.
   - If air-gapped, enforce hardware-level port disablement through the operator appliance (see Appendix A for vendor commands).

3. Stabilize runtime (15–30 minutes)
   - Enable Safemode degrader to reduce model complexity and preserve latency: `rdwctl runtime degrader enable --policy safemode-30pct`
   - Scale down active rollouts and disable canary routing: `rdwctl rollout pause --name <rollout-id>`
   - Pin model to last-known-good: `rdwctl model pin --tenant <tenant-id> --model <model-id>@<sha>`

4. Evacuation and tenant failover (30–90 minutes)
   - If tenant-level isolation is required, initiate tenant evacuation: `rdwctl tenant evacuate --tenant <tenant-id> --mode read-only --drain-time 60s`
   - For VPC customers with regional fallback enabled, trigger regional failover: `rdwctl controlplane failover --tenant <tenant-id> --region fallback-region`
   - Confirm KV-cache snapshot saved: `rdwctl kv snapshot --tenant <tenant-id> --out /var/tmp/tenant-<id>-kv.tgz`

5. Reconciliation and verification (90–240 minutes)
   - Run KV consistency checks: `rdwctl kv check --tenant <tenant-id> --verify-checksum` then `rdwctl kv reconcile --tenant <tenant-id> --strategy incremental`
   - Verify trace completeness and latency recovery via console dashboards and `rdwctl metrics query`
   - If rollback required for model artifacts, follow the rollback playbook below.

Rollback playbook (model, runtime, and control-plane artifacts)

Preconditions: Must have a verified artifact repository snapshot and control-plane checkpoint. If not present, gather evidence and escalate to Product + Security immediately.

1. Pin rollback artifact: `rdwctl model pin --tenant <tenant-id> --model <good-model>@<sha>`
2. Stop progressive rollout agents: `rdwctl rollout stop --selector tenant=<tenant-id>`
3. Orchestrated model swapback: `rdwctl runtime model-swap --tenant <tenant-id> --from <bad-model> --to <good-model> --health-check 30s --parallelism 1`
4. Monitor for errors for 15 minutes; if errors surface, abort and restore previous snapshot.

Operator safety and evidence collection (must-do for regulated customers)

- Preserve forensic artifacts in WORM storage. Minimum evidence set:
  - Console snapshots, Prometheus scraping window (30m before alert to present), model swap logs, KV snapshots, network flow captures (tcpdump), and operator CLI session logs.
- Use built-in evidence collector: `rdwctl evidence collect --incident INCIDENT-PRIV-<id> --out /evidence/INCIDENT-PRIV-<id>`
- Do not delete or trim logs until compliance signoff (owner: security-and-compliance).

Automated guardrails (what the platform will attempt automatically)

- Automatic Safemode: runtime will enable safemode when median latency exceeds 2x SLA for >3 minutes.
- Auto-pause rollouts: failing rollouts with >2% error rate for 5m will be automatically paused.
- KV-check triggers: mismatch in checksum after model swap will trigger a reconcile job with lower priority but immediate alert.
- Egress detection: any outbound to non-whitelisted IPs triggers a network quarantine action and SecOps paging.

Testing and validation (runbook drills)

- Quarterly drills: simulate a model-swap failure in a staging tenant with identical guardrails and practice full evacuation + evidence collection.
- Smoke tests after remediation: synthetic prompt set (10 queries, 99p latency <= 500ms) and correctness checks against pinned evaluation prompts.
- Checklist for validation run:
  1. Confirm KV-snapshot integrity (checksums match)
  2. Confirm model version pinned and active traffic routed correctly
  3. Confirm egress rules restored to policy and audited

Appendix A — Operator commands and common snippets

- Snapshot CLI example:
  rdwctl snapshot --scope incident --out /tmp/incident-20260215.tgz

- Egress block (VPC control-plane proxy):
  rdwctl network block-egress --scope node-group --cidr 0.0.0.0/0 --duration 15m --reason "suspected-exfil"

- KV reconcile: YAML example (operator-run job)
  ---
  job: kv-reconcile
  tenant: "tenant-1234"
  strategy: incremental
  parallelism: 2
  timeout: 3600

Appendix B — Evidence retention mapping

| Artifact | Location | Retention | Owner |
| Model swap logs | /var/log/redwood/model-swap | 90 days | engineering |
| KV snapshots | /evidence/kv | 365 days (archive) | private-deploys |
| Network captures | /evidence/netflows | 180 days | security |

Appendix C — Common failure scenarios and operator notes

- Scenario: Partial KV corruption after heterogeneous model swap
  - Note: Do not restart the runtime layer before KV snapshot is taken. Use reconcile strategy incremental, not replace, unless authorized.

- Scenario: Air-gapped node shows heartbeat loss but hardware telemetry OK
  - Note: Check local proxy and operator appliance (BMC/ILO) logs for process-level faults. If control-plane cannot reach node, switch to out-of-band console; do not perform destructive rollback without snapshots.

Communication templates

- Operator -> Customer (initial):
  Subject: Incident INC-PRIV-<id> — We are investigating degraded performance
  Body: We detected elevated latency impacting your tenant. We have isolated affected nodes, pinned model versions, and are collecting evidence. Estimated initial RCA in 4 hours.

- Customer -> Operator (post-evacuation confirmation):
  Subject: Tenant <id> evacuated to fallback region
  Body: Tenant traffic is successfully routed to fallback-region and responses are within agreed latency SLOs. Please confirm KV snapshots are intact and schedule follow-up for rollback or replay.
